Take The Shape of Evil as Michael Myers or save your neighbors as a Hero of Haddonfield in Halloween, the ultimate asymmetrical horror sandbox.

Utilizing a nightmarish array of abilities, Michael leverages shadows and stealth to satisfy his bloodthirst. This doesn’t mean Haddonfield is going down without a fight. Go on an extravagance shopping spree and equip with killer designer wear. Challenge friends and foes in a style battle showdown in Style Duels and seize the catwalk!_________________________________________  FEATURES- 7 unique fashion brands and looks: Casual, Sporty, Grunge, Minimal, Bohemian, Romantic and Glamorous.- 160 items to fill your closet with.- 7 different cities to travel and complete careers: My Town, Los Angeles, Sydney, Tokyo, Sao Paulo, Shanghai and Rome.- 42 jobs to complete and master.- Over 14,000 combinations of hairstyles, skin, hair and eye colors.- Challenge friends and foes in a style battle showdown in Style Duel.- Play with Mob+ and Facebook friends.- Local and global on a geographical leaderboard._________________________________________  WHAT WE PROMISE - Regular content updates including 20 brands and over 500 costumes_________________________________________  ABOUT MobCretehttp://www.mobcrete.comhttp://facebook.com/mobcretehttp://twitter.com/mobcretehttp://weibo.com/mobcrete

games.name: Of Nooks and Nonsense: A Pirate Hidden Object Game
games.summary:
In Of Nooks and Nonsense: A Pirate Hidden Object Game, you explore a moment in chaos and calamity out on the seas. And through the haze of hand drawn art and delightful music you are tasked with finding 100 things. 

They are out there. Its up to you to find them.

games.name: PaoHuZi
games.summary: Tap, jump and slide your way through a variety of obstacles. Jump over trash cans, slide over cars, kick pestering cyclists, tag walls and more. Run through the streets and alleyways to unlock achievements and earn coins. Spend coins in the shop to purchase wacky hats, gloves, shoes and items such as battle axes, swords, whips and ice cream cones. Purchase awesome power-ups to overcome obstacles with ease. Serious stickman fun awaits you in this free adventure!Features:•Plenty of obstacles•Over 25 achievements•Game Center support•Over 25,000 combinations of wacky hats, gloves, shoes and items!•Sweet power-ups!

games.name: Pegture
games.summary: Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

games.name: Seven Blasphemies
games.summary: Seven Blasphemies is a traditional turn-based roguelike where every dawn may curse your run forever. Explore a dying world, choose from doomed classes, survive lethal OSR-inspired encounters, and race against extinction before the seventh blasphemy ends all.

games.name: Space Carrier Zero
games.summary: One carrier against the sector's whole navy. The guns fire themselves, you steer the bow, pick the route, and decide how long to stay before the alarm brings the fleet down on you. Collect permanent cards that increase your strength each run. Five acts with increasing battle scope.

games.name: Spellsteel
games.summary: A free-to-play fantasy collectible card game where six civilizations battle to claim the legendary Kharadum Codex. Build your deck, command legendary Champions, and master deep tactical PvP.

games.name: SPRAWL zero
games.summary: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

games.name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
games.summary:
Your colonists are hungry for more than survival. Provide your colonists with various delicacies and build local production to create the ultimate Martian diet in Surviving Mars: Relaunched — Feeding the Future.

After all, survival comes in many flavors!

games.name: TAMA JIGOKU
games.summary: Another great casino old school simulation!!!!Now you can play the most famous slot machine with no money to have great fun with your friends.Features :- Bonus 5 of a kind on 3 positions- Bonus All symbols with free spins- Change which symbol to carry- Bet 50 / 100 / 200- Payout to get HighScore- HighScore can be posted on own Facebook WallThe game will be updated regularly, so suggest us improvements and notice us bugs on our forum.Enjoy!

games.name: Trouble Thief
games.summary: Steal your way through 30 levels. Just pick up the loot and carry it back to the safe zone, no problem. Each level has very challenging time trials and a no-hit challenge. The game is mainly designed around beating the levels as fast as possible.

games.name: TRUDGE
games.summary: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

games.name: Underkeep (chris lee)
games.summary: The military special forces have elite snipers trained for combat. You alone must eliminate the hostile threat and return the hostages to safety! Can you save them and save yourself?Battle your friends across the Game Center Leaderboards!

games.name: Violet Stardust
games.summary: OH SIT! We hope you’ve stretched your sitting muscles, ‘cause you’re about to see some serious sit… no buts about it! Come play musical chairs like you never have before. In OH SIT! you’ll dance, jump, bounce, and battle your way up five tiers of the 3D OH SIT! tower through obstacles including platforms, springs, spikes, and canons. It's king of the mountain and musical chairs rolled into one. Collect virtual money as you race up the face of a daunting tower in a challenging, competitive, hilarious race to claim your chair at the top!WARNING: money earned in the game is in no way reflective to real world currency, that would be crazy.  Do you like amazing awesome helmets and hats? Us too! Unlock all six when you score big money! Do you like prizes in the form of powerups? OH SIT! brings you the Cash Magnet, the Beat Box, Homing Missiles, Earthquake Machines, and Super Shoes.  Make it to the top of the tower, and you might make it to the top of the charts!

games.name: VOXEL DRIFT RACER
games.summary: Top-down arcade drift racing in a voxel world. Race 12 tracks across 12 modes, unlock cars and parts with coins you earn, then build your own circuits and voxel cars in the editors and take them online. No microtransactions.

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace.

A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game. Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea.

Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates - Buccaneers
Detective VR
games.summary:
DETECTIVE VR is a narrative investigation game for Meta Quest 3 & 3S: You can control time, collect clues and interview witnesses in Passthrough. The investigation takes place in your living room.

Explore unreliable testimonies and confront suspects to find out what happened!

A mix between ObraDinn/Immortality and Minority Report: An innovative way to tell a story in Mixed Reality.

games.summary: Reset is a card game in which you have to find groups of three cards, which are either all the same, or all different, in four categories: shape of the object, number of objects, fill pattern, and color. You get a full deck of 81 cards to play with!

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident.The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies.The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

Ghost in the SQL Data Demo
Hazard Pay
games.summary:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process.

Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.

games.name: HimaNatsu: Of Churches, Sunflowers, and Long Summers
Hitherto: School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
games.summary:
Race beyond the orange track and jump into a Hot Wheels™-sized world with four islands to explore, each with its own vibe and challenges. Roam freely through a world full of adventures, smash obstacles, discover secret items, and take on epic activities.

BECOME THE RUSH MASTER
Each island is ruled by a Rush Master – the ultimate boss to defeat. Complete events to unlock their challenge, and beat them to claim their car and title. Once you've conquered all four, be crowned the one true Rush Master!

PICK YOUR RIDE
Master four unique vehicle types: all-out Versatiles, massive Titans, agile Drifters, and lightning-fast Speeders. Each offers a different way to race. Choose your favorite rides, build your Rush Squad, and get ready for any challenge. And don't stop there: show off by customizing your car, right down to the wheels!

A COLLECTION LIKE NO OTHER
Discover and collect 150+ vehicles through events, activities, and challenges. Unlock rare models, fill your garage, and hit the road with some of the most iconic Hot Wheels™ out there.

MAKE THE WORLD YOUR TRACK
With the new Track Builder, create next-level tracks using the world around you. Attach modules to the ground, build around buildings, or race above the city, weaving around towering skyscrapers.

ENDLESS FUN
Take on a variety of game modes including single-player, split-screen with up to four players, and online multiplayer with full cross-play*. Climb the leaderboards, prove your skills, and race your way to the top!

games.name: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard)
Kubo 3
games.summary:
Join KUBO in this new adventure that will take you to the four corners of the world in search of the sacred crystals to free the inhabitants kidnapped by the infamous Moglar!

Journey through the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater world and the skies. Collect the items... There will be many monsters and bosses on your way, before the final battle in your enemy's castle!

games.name: Orca Gril: Idle Fishing Story Demo
The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline
games.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

Aniimo

Welcome to Aniimo, the new free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world ARPG.

As a Pathfinder, you’ll begin your journey in Idyll, a dynamic, interactive and expansive open world! There, you can collect, evolve, and twine with magical creatures called Aniimo.

Get ready to explore uncharted landscapes and mysterious dungeons, battle in real-time PvE and PvP combat, solve ancient puzzles, and master a truly dynamic gameplay experience.

G-MODEアーカイブス+ リッジレーサー
I was reincarnated as a mage.
Jigsaw Diorama: The Alchemist and the Eclipse
Project Motor Racing: V8 Power Pack
Train Sim World 7
games.summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

games.name: AKIBA LOST
games.summary:
13 years ago, six girls mysteriously vanished in Akihabara - an unsolved case known as “Akiba’s Spirited Away.”

At the annual Game Show, Daiki Shinjo, once hailed as a “genius creator,” boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST. But the moment he does, strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi - each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

Yet, the story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.

It all begins with a threatening phone call - and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Cancel the game’s development - or the tragedy will repeat itself."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect his friends? Who is behind it all? And what really happened thirteen years ago?

games.name: Another Eden Begins
games.summary:
Aldo and his younger sister, Feinne, enjoy a peaceful life in the idyllic village of Baruoki, until one day, when Feinne is taken by the Beast King. 

Aldo pursues them into the Moonlight Forest, but following a fierce battle with a beast, he is sent through a tear in spacetime - and finds himself in a world 800 years in the future.

Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

games.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO Soundtrack
MONOWAVE
games.summary:
In MONOWAVE, embark on an exploratory adventure shaped by emotion, atmosphere and discovery. Play as Mono, a newborn Guardian tasked with restoring balance to a broken world by reuniting the four Emotions: Anger, Anxiety, Happiness and Sorrow. As the guardian spirit of the Emotions, Mono can use emotional powers to interact with the eccentric inhabitants of each world, soothe four rampaging Emotions, and help them regain their balance before the world unravels any further.

Guide Mono through a series of evocative worlds, using observation and emotional awareness to overcome environmental challenges and connect with the world around them. Through thoughtful platforming, puzzle-driven progression and empathetic encounters with characters, uncover a heartfelt story that explores the complicated but meaningful ways different emotions manifest in our lives.

Players can experience MONOWAVE’s first chapter on Steam, offering roughly one hour of gameplay. Set in World 1, “The Panic Jungle,” a realm consumed by anxiety, players will learn MONOWAVE’s core emotion-based mechanics and face the first boss encounter, offering a hands-on introduction to the game’s heartfelt world ahead of its September 16th launch.

games.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup Demo
PATLABOR the Case Files
games.summary:
Labors. The generic term for robots developed for industrial use. Widely adopted in construction and civil engineering, crimes involving Labors rapidly increased. The Metropolitan Police Department established the Special Vehicle Section 2 Patrol Labor Squadron to counter this threat. Thus the "Patlabor" was born.

Relive numerous iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this home console 3D action game. Play from different perspectives - Main Missions as Special Vehicle Section 2, and Another Side Missions as their adversaries.

Over 20 Labors appear in the game Master everything from the Ingram to the Griffon and Type Zero Includes Simulator Mode where you can engage in shooting practice and Labor-vs-Labor combat.

games.name: PATLABOR the Case Files Original Soundtrack
Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary:
Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. 

There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

Roman Sands RE:Build is a delirium-charged journey into apocalypse which collides through visual novel, adventure, puzzle solving, horror, and survival simulation.

games.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
games.summary: Turn the page on the explosive 2nd chapter of Nihon Falcom’s legendary Trails saga! Estelle Bright sets out on a new journey across Liberl to uncover the truth behind Joshua’s disappearance and defeat the sinister Ouroboros organization.

games.name: VHS Nights: The Tidy Up Shift
Woodo
games.summary:
Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle game based on simple diorama assembly mechanics with a beautiful visual style. 

The game is a reminiscence of childhood memories playing with a tiny wooden constructor, immersing players in a peaceful, safe and creative world.

games.name: 100 Cats Lost in China 2 Find & Color
Sniper Dan
games.summary:
Sniper Dan is a ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a high-powered sniper rifle to solve low-stakes problems. Scope the scene, spot the problem, and shoot the solution. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. 

Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

games.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
CONTROL Resonant
games.summary:
With Control, we leaped into the unknown. We wanted to create something new. Something different and unexpected. A world like no other. 

With Control 2, we'll take another leap into the unknown. It'll be an unexpected journey.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: SILENT HILL: Townfall, a co-production with Annapurna Interactive (Stray) and multiple BAFTA award winning No Code Studios (Stories Untold, Observation).

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.
